Watts made this hymn from Psalm 31:5, "in the language of the New Testament": a paraphrase, not a translation. The line that comes closest to it is marked.
Into Your hands I commit my spirit; You have redeemed me, O LORD, God of truth. PSALM 31:5 · BEREAN STANDARD BIBLE READ PSALM 31
Into thine hand, O God of truth, My spirit I commit; Thou hast redeem'd my soul from death, And sav'd me from the pit. STANZA I
Watts's psalms run from Psalm 1 to Psalm 150, several settings to many psalms: 367 hymns. This is number 1. Point at a tick to see the hymn; click it to open that hymn.
